54699.meaning1: with acute sense of taste; twenty-first of the thirty-two marks of a great man
54699.commentary: (MNa) rasaggas'aggī'ti ettha rasaṃ gasantī'ti rasaggasā, rasaharaṇīnam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, tā aggā assā'ti rasaggas'aggī.

examples.text: rasaggas'aggī kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
